{{Top|leg}}
'''Light plating type 1''' was an excellent option for light-duty [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. This thin sheet of alloy plating was a relatively inexpensive way to improve a droid's chance of surviving combat.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''
